name: Giuoco Piano — Black Tactics
description: 4 tactical challenges for Black in the Italian Game. Find the counter-move after White's most common 12th moves!

drills.name: Solidify the Center
drills.description: Black reinforces the knight on d5 with c6 and prepares counter-play against White's center.
drills.briefExplanation: Black reinforces the knight on d5 and prepares counter-play against White's center.
drills.explanation: Re8 puts immediate pressure down the e-file. Black continues with 14...Qc7 and 15...Rad8, fully coordinating the rooks against the d4-pawn. This neutralizes White's pressure on d5 and sets up long-term central counter-play while keeping the position solid.

drills.name: Knight Outpost on f5
drills.description: Black plants the knight on a strong central outpost, immediately attacking the d4-pawn and eyeing e3.
drills.briefExplanation: Black plants the knight on a strong central outpost, immediately attacking the d4-pawn and eyeing e3.
drills.explanation: Nxd4 captures the central pawn. If White recaptures 14.Nxd4, Black follows with 15...Ne3, forking the queen and rook or creating powerful pressure on White's position. This often wins material or forces awkward concessions from White.

drills.name: Queenside Expansion
drills.description: Black gains space on the queenside and kicks the bishop on c4, then expands with a5.
drills.briefExplanation: Black gains space on the queenside and kicks the bishop on c4.
drills.explanation: a5 prepares further expansion. Black continues with 14...a4 and 15...Ba6, developing the bishop with tempo and restricting White's pieces while controlling key queenside squares.

drills.name: Defensive Resource vs Ng5
drills.description: Black kicks White's attacking knight on g5 to defend the weak f7-pawn, then recaptures the sacrifice.
drills.briefExplanation: Black kicks the attacking knight on g5 to defend the weak f7-pawn.
drills.explanation: If White sacrifices 13.Nxf7, Black recaptures with the rook. Black then plays 14...Qxf7 (if needed) or 14...Rf8, maintaining material equality while neutralizing White's attack and keeping the position safe.
